facts.title: 1. LAUNCH WINDOW
facts.text: Earth and Mars line up for the most energy-efficient trip only about once every 26 months. MER's two rockets launched in the 2003 window.

facts.title: 2. MAX-Q
facts.text: As the rocket speeds up through the air, the push of the air on it grows to a maximum called Max Q. Engines can be throttled down to get through it safely.

facts.title: 3. ESCAPE SPEED
facts.text: To leave Earth's gravity behind, a rocket must reach about 11.2 km per second: more than 40,000 km/h!

real.text: Spirit launched on June 10, 2003 and Opportunity on July 7, 2003, each on a Delta II rocket from Cape Canaveral, Florida.
